dedupe_keys.name: a benchmark gaofen 7 dataset for building extraction from satellite images

description: A benchmark GaoFen-7 dataset for building extraction from satellite images is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Peimin Chen et al. Accurate building extraction helps describe urban form, but it often requires a substantial number of building samples. While some building datasets are available for model training, there remains a lack of high-quality building datasets covering urban and rural areas in China. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2024. Formats: Image, ZIP. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 9973258979 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
